draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling has a lower median latency than Talmar (41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 and T1.r2.lat=118 directly support a lower-latency claim. The hedge "may" understates the reported measurement. However, the two latencies were measured on different accelerators/precisions (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32), so the claim should stay descriptive of the reported medians rather than assert a general speed advantage.
